info.title: Globetrot API
info.description: Operations of the Globetrot application. Authenticated with the session cookie set by `/api/auth/*`; the caller is always the session owner and no request field can name another user.

cookieAuth.name: globetrot.session_token
cookieAuth.description: The session cookie set by sign-in (`__Secure-globetrot.session_token` over https). Browsers send it by themselves.

get.summary: Which social sign-in buttons to show
get.description: Public. A provider is listed only when the server has it configured, so a screen never offers a button that cannot work. Email and password is always available and is not listed.

providers.description: The social sign-in providers that are configured and can be offered.

get.description: Only the caller’s own id, email, name and whether the email is verified.

get.description: Language, preferred currency, home country, nationality, time zone and units. They are independent: none is derived from another. A user who saved nothing gets USD, the default language and no country, nationality or time zone.

theme.description: Look of the app: a designed theme, or `system` to follow the OS.

motion.description: Amount of animation. The OS reduced-motion setting wins over `full`.

post.description: The amount is in `currency`. When that is not the trip’s currency, send `fxRate` (how much of the trip’s currency 1 unit is worth); the server converts, and keeps the rate, its source (`manual`) and its date with the cost. The converted amount is never taken from the client.

amount.description: Major units as a decimal string.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Defaults to USD.

fxRate.description: Required when `currency` is not the trip’s: how much of the trip’s currency 1 unit of `currency` is worth.

fxAsOf.description: The day the rate was taken. Defaults to today.
